title: (RHBA-2023:6211) Red Hat JBoss Web Server 6.0.0 release
portal_summary: An update is now available for Red Hat JBoss Web Server.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat JBoss Web Server 6.0.0 release
portal_product_filter: JBoss Enterprise Web Server|JBoss Enterprise Web Server|Text-Only Advisories|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat JBoss Web Server is a fully integrated and certified set of components for hosting Java web applications. It is comprised of the Apache Tomcat Servlet container, JBoss HTTP Connector (mod_cluster), the PicketLink Vault extension for Apache Tomcat, and the Tomcat Native library.

This release of Red Hat JBoss Web Server 6.0.0 serves as a replacement for Red Hat JBoss Web Server 5.7.6. This release includes bug fixes, enhancements and component upgrades, which are documented in the Release Notes, linked to in the References section.
